title: 第23章 寒冰剑圣第24章 打通窍穴
slug: 噬神塔第1929章小金的战力
lines: 三日后，碧水寒潭开启。
大清早，小胖就带着秦易，来到了寒潭前。
刚一靠近，就能感觉到，彻骨的寒冷，扑面而来。
碧水寒潭在外门后山山顶上，一眼望去，直径大约有百米左右，深不见底。
寒潭上方，笼罩着灰蒙蒙的雾气。
隐约能看到剑气纵横在寒潭之内。
守护长老拦住了两人，秦易将令牌拿出。
检查完毕后，守护长老放行，让秦易进入其中。
“直接跳进去就行，如果实在坚持不下去，就自动出来。”守护长老提醒道。
噗通！
秦易纵身一跃，跳入了碧水寒潭中。
而小胖，则是跟守护长老闲聊。
“长老，我记得碧水寒潭此前的记录，应该是刘玄保持的吧？”小胖问道。
守护长老道，“不错，刘玄当时坚持了七十二天，打破了天剑宗历史记录，一直持续至今，无人能触及这个记录，甚至连接近都做不到。”
七十二天！
小胖内心震颤。
他当初在碧水寒潭中，只坚持了三天就不行了。
大部分新入门的弟子，撑死也就坚持三四天，特别优秀的能坚持七八天。
就算是如今的外门第一弟子石洛，也只坚持了三十六天。
“不知道秦师弟能坚持多久？”小胖充满了好奇。
守护长老面无表情的说道：“一个连入门考核都要作弊的人，你指望他坚持几天？”
不得不说。
副宗主定性，再加上三长老派系的高层们渲染后，秦易在天剑宗的名声的确不太好。
碧水寒潭的守护长老，十分痛恨这种投机取巧者。
对秦易没有任何好感，直接说道：“他能坚持一天就不错了。”
小胖连连摇头，“那可不一定，秦师弟可不是一般人，他是剑道天才。”
“天才？”守护长老嗤笑。
“他在武斗场中，达成了十连胜成就。”小胖不服气的说道。
嗯？
闻言，守住长老微微蹙眉。
旋即道：“那肯定是趁着外门那些优秀弟子不在的时候达成的。”
“你……”小胖可比任何人都清楚，秦易的实力有多强？
连外门第十的紫幻，都败下阵来。
但是想了想，他跟一个守护长老解释什么。
秦易能坚持多少天，等他从碧水寒潭出来不就知道了。
content_en:
Three days later, the Blue Water Cold Pool opened.
Early in the morning, Xiaopang took Qin Yi to the cold pool.
As soon as you get close, you can feel the bone-chilling cold hitting your face.
The Bishui Hantan is on the top of the mountain behind the outer gate. At a glance, it is about a hundred meters in diameter and bottomless.
A gray mist shrouded the top of the cold pool.
You can vaguely see the sword energy crisscrossing the cold pool.
The guardian elder stopped the two of them, and Qin Yi took out the token.
After the inspection, the guardian elder let Qin Yi enter.
"Just jump in. If you really can't hold on, come out automatically." The guardian elder reminded.
Plop!
Qin Yi jumped into the cold pool of clear water.
Xiaopang, on the other hand, was chatting with the guardian elder.
"Elder, I remember that the previous record of Bishui Hantan should be maintained by Liu Xuan, right?" Xiaopang asked.
The guardian elder said, "Yes, Liu Xuan persisted for seventy-two days, breaking the historical record of Tianjian Sect. It has continued to this day. No one can touch this record, or even come close."
Seventy-two days!
Xiaopang's heart trembled.
He only lasted three days in the cold pool of clear water and died.
Most new disciples can only hold on for three or four days, and the best ones can hold on for seven or eight days.
Even Shi Luo, the current top disciple of the outer sect, only lasted thirty-six days.
"I wonder how long Junior Brother Qin can hold on?" Xiaopang was full of curiosity.
The guardian elder said expressionlessly: "A person who even cheats on entrance exams, how many days do you expect him to persist?"
I have to say.
After the deputy sect leader's determination and the exaggeration by the senior officials of the three elders faction, Qin Yi's reputation in the Tianjian Sect is indeed not very good.
The guardian elder of Bishui Hantan hates such opportunists very much.
He didn't have any good impressions of Qin Yi and said directly: "It's good if he can persist for one day."
Xiaopang shook his head repeatedly, "That's not necessarily the case. Junior Brother Qin is not an ordinary person. He is a swordsman genius."
"Genius?" the guardian elder sneered.
"He achieved ten consecutive victories in the martial arts arena." Xiaopang said unconvinced.
Um?
Hearing this, the guarding elder frowned slightly.
Immediately he said: "That must have been achieved while those outstanding disciples from the outer sect were away."
"You..." Xiaopang knows better than anyone else how strong Qin Yi is?
Even Zi Huan, who was ranked tenth in the outer sect, was defeated.
But after thinking about it, he wondered what to explain to a guardian elder.
How many days Qin Yi can hold on will be known when he comes out of the cold blue water pool.
